'''''Most Wanted''''' is a [[canon]] young-adult novel written by [[Rae Carson]] that focuses on [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] shortly before the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. It was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[May 25]], [[2018]], in concert with the film.
